mentions.name: doldecomp/melee
mentions.description: A community decompilation project for Super Smash Bros. Melee, reconstructing the game's code function by function. The author has completed several functions by hand and is exploring how to leverage AI to speed up the decompilation process, inviting others to join in.
mentions.audience: Contributors invited to help decompile Super Smash Bros. Melee ("Come decompile with us!")
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm dipping my toes into decompilation -- specifically, decompiling Super Smash Bros. Melee. Once you get into the groove, it's kinda addicting!
